Side A · Recipe 01

The spiral of fifths

Cosmic arpeggio from one note

Play one note; it grows into a rising cascade of fifths that melts into a dark cloud. It sounds like a whole chord played by someone else.

Level
Medium
Setup
15 min
Key
A minor pentatonic (notes A and E)
  1. OXI One MK2sequencer
  2. PERfourMER MKIIsynth
  3. Grand Canyondelay
  4. NightSkyreverb
  1. What you'll hear
  2. 1. PERfourMER: a short note with a clear attack
  3. 2. Grand Canyon: PITCH, where the magic happens

What you'll hear

One short note. Then its echo a fifth higher, then a fifth above that, climbing like stairs: C, G, D, A, E. The reverb blurs the stairs into a chord and darkens the top, so it stays warm. The dry bass sits underneath.

The rule of this recipe: the Grand Canyon makes the notes; the NightSky blurs and darkens them. If both added high sounds, it would be noise.

1. PERfourMER: a short note with a clear attack

Synth channel 1, on MIDI channel 1. Turn synth channels 3 and 4 VOLUME fully down.

  • WAVEsinetrianglesquaresawnoiseEXTRich in harmonics, so each echo is easy to hear.
  • OCTAVE8'Middle register: the spiral climbs almost 3 octaves from here.
  • Oscillator EG INTnoonCentre: no pitch envelope.
  • Oscillator LFO INTnoonCentre: no vibrato, so the fifths stay in tune.
  • CUTOFF11 o'clockSlightly open.
  • RESONANCE9 o'clockA touch of bite.
  • Filter EG INT1 o'clockThe envelope opens the filter a little at each note: a clear attack.
  • TRACK0%50%100%Higher notes stay bright enough.
  • VCA MODEEGGATEONThe envelope shapes the volume.
  • ATTACKminInstant start.
  • DECAY10 o'clockShort note: it leaves room between repeats, so you hear each echo separately.
  • SUSTAINminNo held tail.
  • RELEASE9 o'clockA short fade, no click.
  • PANnoonIn the main left output, which feeds the pedals.

2. Grand Canyon: PITCH, where the magic happens

Start from neutral (see the rig page): only the DELAY LED lit, and EXP MODE, MOMENT, TAILS and PING PONG unlit.

  • DELAY TYPEPITCHTurn the big knob until the PITCH LED lights.
  • Secondary modeHold PING PONG about 2 s, until the PITCH LED blinks, then let goThe key step: each echo is shifted again, so one echo a fifth up becomes a staircase. (By default every echo has the same pitch.)
  • MODE (left mini knob)Step 5 of 5: upward shift + dryModes 1 and 5 feed your dry note into the delay, so the spiral starts from your note, not straight from the fifth.
  • PITCH (right mini knob)Step 7 of 12: perfect 5thFifths from C: C, G, D, A, E. Those five notes are the pentatonic scale, the "nothing clashes" scale, so the spiral builds a pretty chord on its own.
  • FEEDBACK9:30 o'clockStart here, then raise it slowly. Each repeat climbs 7 semitones; five climb almost 3 octaves, and the top gets grainy and squeals.
  • TAP DIVPress until the eighth + DOT LEDs lightA dotted eighth falls between the beats, so the cascade skips across the rhythm like a live arpeggiator, not a metronome.
  • TempoTap the TAP/LOOP footswitch on each beat of the OXI's tempoThe tapped time is a quarter note; TAP DIV turns it into a dotted eighth.
  • DELAY LVL1 o'clockPast 2 o'clock the dry signal starts to drop; at max you'd hear only echoes and lose your note.
  • PING PONGCheck its light after the 2 s holdPress it once to set it how you like. On, the stairs bounce left and right.

3. NightSky: blur the stairs into a cloud

  • TEXTUREsparsedensediffuseDiffuse is a slow-building, atmospheric wash: it turns single steps into one sound.
  • LENGTH2 o'clockA long tail, so each new note lands on the last one's cloud.
  • SIZE/PITCHnoonMiddle: the reverb isn't pitched up or down.
  • FILTERregenlow passThe most important setting here. Regen cuts highs inside the regenerating core, so the reverb gets darker as it decays.
  • HIGH CUT11 o'clockThe spiral goes very high; this takes the sharp top off the tail. Warm, not piercing.
  • LOW CUT10 o'clockCuts lows at the output and in the core, so the reverb leaves room for the bass.
  • TARGETverbpitchfilterModulation moves the reverb's delay lines.
  • SHAPEtrianglesquarerampsawrandomenvAn even rise and fall.
  • SPEED8 o'clockSlow: the cloud breathes.
  • DEPTH10 o'clockGentle.
  • SHIMMER (knob)minOff. The spiral already makes the high notes; shimmer would add more and turn it to chaos.
  • GLIMMERhighlowoffLow brings out lower harmonics: mysterious, synth-like. A counterweight to the high spiral.
  • DRIVEprepostoffClean.
  • DRYnoonNoon is unity: your signal at the same volume.
  • REVERB1 o'clockCloud a little under the dry signal. Raise it for more space.

4. The OXI One: play it

Sequencer 1 (Mono, Ch 1) plays the spiral; sequencer 2 (Mono, Ch 2) plays the bass.

  1. Set the tempo: hold Shift, turn knob 1. Around 80–90 BPM gives the spiral time.
  2. Sequencer 1: tap one note per bar, or one every two bars, on step 1: start with A. Less is more: the spiral does the rest.
  3. Keep the gate short: hold the step's pad and turn knob 3 until it's one step long.
  4. Sequencer 2 (the bass patch from the rig page): a low A on step 1, tied across the bar (hold the pad and turn knob 3 quickly clockwise).
  5. Change the note rarely. Each note builds its own pentatonic stairs, so notes a fifth apart sound best together: A, then E.

You got it right when

  • One OXI note gives you five or so rising notes, each a fifth above the last, not the same note repeating.
  • The top of the spiral sounds warm, not piercing.
  • The bass is clear underneath.

5. The performance

  • Climax: press INFINITE on the NightSky. It holds the cloud and still lets new sound in on top (that's the factory setting, Infinite Input: on), so the cloud stands still and you play new notes over it.
  • Way out: release INFINITE and turn the Grand Canyon's FEEDBACK down. The spiral shortens and the cloud slowly fades.

If it sounds wrong

  • Every echo has the same pitch: secondary mode is off. Hold PING PONG again until the PITCH LED blinks.
  • It squeals: FEEDBACK down a little, or HIGH CUT further left.
  • Your note disappears: DELAY LVL is past 2 o'clock.
  • Mud: shorter DECAY on the PERfourMER, or LENGTH down on the NightSky.

Sources

  • Grand Canyon manual: PITCH modes and intervals (p. 19), secondary mode (p. 34), DELAY LVL (p. 8), TAP DIV (p. 12).
  • NightSky manual: TEXTURE (p. 5), FILTER, HIGH CUT, LOW CUT (p. 4), GLIMMER (p. 9), MOD (pp. 10–11), DRY (p. 12), INFINITE and Infinite Input (p. 18), factory settings (p. 41).
  • PERfourMER MKII manual: oscillator, filter, VCA and envelope (pp. 7–20).
  • OXI One MKII manual: tempo (p. 62), gate and ties (p. 55), sequencer setup (p. 125).
